pages.title: Merging Potions
pages.text: Brew any potion together with mundane hexbrew and a flame cattail to convert it into drinkable witch hexbrew, keeping the potion's effects. The catalyst sets the tier: ghost fire cap (tier 1), star flower (tier 2), or dragon breath (tier 3).

pages.title: Splash & Enhancing
pages.text: Add gunpowder to a merge to get throwable witch splash instead, or brew plain witch hexbrew with gunpowder 1:1 later. Re-brewing witch hexbrew (or splash) with flame cattail, blaze powder and redstone enhances its stored effects.
